assessments.reasoning: The generated exception JSON in SPDX’s pinned repository supplies the exact identifier, display name, status, text and three seeAlso entries at bytes [4,1188). The GNU AX_PTHREAD URL also appears in the specimen.
The unsigned annotated tag v3.29.0 in SPDX’s repository targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, the commit serving the macro JSON. The tag establishes the release association.

Both contiguous captures identify the same 23,586-byte Archive file and digest. Its LICENSE section supplies the full publisher-side text for comparison, including the limitation to configure scripts produced when processing the macro.

challenge.method: Checked SPDX’s alternative witnesses and compared the object of the grant with the two FSF texts. Checked the source for a verbatim SPDX identifier.
challenge.results: SPDX cites the GNU AX_PTHREAD page, freedesktop/xorg-macros at 39f07f7db58ebbf3dcb64a2bf9098ed5cf3d1223 and Ubuntu Precise’s xmltooling copyright record on Launchpad. The acquired macro itself contains the distinctive owner, processing and modification language. Its header omits the SPDX short ID. The alternative citations do not determine AX_PTHREAD’s base.

limitations: The source presents commented, indented text. The finding concerns its correspondence to the decoded SPDX text. Other cited examples were not independently opened and supply no additional corroboration here.
reasoning: SPDX 3.29.0 assigns Autoconf-exception-macro to the two-paragraph macro-owner permission and records isDeprecatedLicenseId false. Both paragraphs correspond to AX_PTHREAD’s inline exception, including the Archive-release qualification and the optional extension to modified versions.
